title: pAMM Simulation Quality
description: Whether pAMM quotes from Titan's price level stream reproduce on chain with their simulation overrides, and whether the assumptions the overrides rest on still hold.

panels.title: Swaps that did not revert, by venue
panels.description: Share of price level swaps simulated with their overrides that did not revert: succeeded / (succeeded + reverted + failed). Stale quotes, swaps simulated without overrides, are left out. The next panel says how close the non-reverting swaps came to the quote. A drop means the overrides no longer let the venue fill.

targets.expr: (sum by (protocol) (rate(tycho_integration_simulation_execution_success_total{job=~"$job", protocol=~"pricelevelstream:($venue)"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (protocol) (rate({__name__=~"tycho_integration_simulation_execution_(success|reverts|failures)_total", job=~"$job", protocol=~"pricelevelstream:($venue)"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (protocol) (rate({__name__=~"tycho_integration_simulation_execution_(success|reverts|failures)_total", job=~"$job", protocol=~"pricelevelstream:($venue)"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Swaps within 0.01% of the quote, by venue
panels.description: Share of the non-reverting price level swaps whose simulated output came within 0.01% (1 basis point) of the quoted amount, from the tycho_integration_simulation_execution_slippage_ratio buckets. A drop means the overrides no longer reproduce the quote.

targets.expr: (sum by (protocol) (rate(tycho_integration_simulation_execution_slippage_ratio_bucket{job=~"$job", protocol=~"pricelevelstream:($venue)", le="0.01"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum by (protocol) (rate(tycho_integration_simulation_execution_slippage_ratio_bucket{job=~"$job", protocol=~"pricelevelstream:($venue)", le="-0.01"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (protocol) (rate(tycho_integration_simulation_execution_slippage_ratio_count{job=~"$job", protocol=~"pricelevelstream:($venue)"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Swap outcomes, all venues
panels.description: Price level swaps simulated per second, by outcome. Stale: simulated without overrides and reverted on the venue's freshness guard, which is expected.

panels.title: Swaps simulated without overrides, by venue
panels.description: Share of price level swaps whose state carried no simulation overrides (tycho_integration_price_level_simulation_overrides_missing_total). Such a swap meets the venue's mined price and usually reverts. A small share is normal: the first update after a restart, an auto-detected venue's first message, and books Titan published no entry for.

targets.expr: (sum by (protocol) (rate(tycho_integration_price_level_simulation_overrides_missing_total{job=~"$job", protocol=~"pricelevelstream:($venue)"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (protocol) (rate({__name__=~"tycho_integration_simulation_execution_(success|reverts|failures)_total|tycho_integration_execution_stale_quotes_total", job=~"$job", protocol=~"pricelevelstream:($venue)"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (protocol) (rate({__name__=~"tycho_integration_simulation_execution_(success|reverts|failures)_total|tycho_integration_execution_stale_quotes_total", job=~"$job", protocol=~"pricelevelstream:($venue)"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Slippage between the quote and the simulated swap, by venue
panels.description: Median and 99th percentile of tycho_integration_simulation_execution_slippage_ratio, in percent of the quote, for non-reverting price level swaps. Zero means the simulated swap returned exactly the quoted amount.

panels.title: Reverts and failures over the range, by venue and error category
panels.description: Price level swaps that reverted or failed over the selected range. A revert of a swap simulated with overrides, including one on the freshness guard, means the overrides did not let the venue fill.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (protocol, error_category) (increase(tycho_integration_simulation_execution_reverts_total{job=~"$job", protocol=~"pricelevelstream:($venue)"}[$__range])), "outcome", "reverted", "", "") > 0 or label_replace(sum by (protocol, error_category) (increase(tycho_integration_simulation_execution_failures_total{job=~"$job", protocol=~"pricelevelstream:($venue)"}[$__range])), "outcome", "failed", "", "") > 0

panels.title: Quoted blocks the RPC never served
panels.description: Price level updates dropped because the RPC did not return the quoted block within the poll window (tycho_integration_price_level_target_block_misses_total).

panels.title: States that got overrides, by venue
panels.description: Share of the stream's states that got simulation overrides: outcome same_sequence or earlier_sequence over all outcomes. In the 2026-10-21 recording, 99.7% of books matched.

targets.expr: (sum by (venue) (rate(price_level_stream_override_match_total{job=~"$job", venue=~"$venue", outcome=~"same_sequence|earlier_sequence"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (venue) (rate(price_level_stream_override_match_total{job=~"$job", venue=~"$venue"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (venue) (rate(price_level_stream_override_match_total{job=~"$job", venue=~"$venue"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Match outcomes
panels.description: How each state's overrides were found. same_sequence: an entry of the book's quote sequence. earlier_sequence: the newest entry below it in the same slot. none_in_slot: no entry for the venue and pair in the book's slot. no_quote_sequence: the book named none.

panels.title: Quote addresses merged and skipped, by venue
panels.description: Per state with overrides, how many other quote addresses' entries were merged in, and how many were skipped because none of their entries was at or below the book's quote sequence. Metric merges 0x30a88bf8…; 0x6dca2500… is skipped on Metric's WETH/USDT states, which do not read its state.

panels.title: Quote sequence not in its slot
panels.description: Increase of price_level_stream_sequence_slot_mismatch_total over the selected range. Each counts a case the matching rules assume never happens; any value above zero means Titan changed how it sends data, and the rule should be revisited.

targets.legendFormat: Quote sequence not in its slot

panels.title: Messages without a slot
panels.description: Increase of price_level_stream_messages_without_slot_total over the selected range. Each counts a case the matching rules assume never happens; any value above zero means Titan changed how it sends data, and the rule should be revisited.

panels.title: Entries missing a field
panels.description: Increase of price_level_stream_override_entry_missing_field_total over the selected range. Each counts a case the matching rules assume never happens; any value above zero means Titan changed how it sends data, and the rule should be revisited.

panels.title: Entry and book blocks differ
panels.description: Increase of price_level_stream_override_block_mismatch_total over the selected range. Each counts a case the matching rules assume never happens; any value above zero means Titan changed how it sends data, and the rule should be revisited.

panels.title: Duplicate books
panels.description: Increase of price_level_stream_duplicate_books_total over the selected range. Each counts a case the matching rules assume never happens; any value above zero means Titan changed how it sends data, and the rule should be revisited.

panels.title: Unreadable quote sequences
panels.description: Increase of price_level_stream_unreadable_quote_sequence_total over the selected range. Each counts a case the matching rules assume never happens; any value above zero means Titan changed how it sends data, and the rule should be revisited.

panels.title: Buffer events
panels.description: What the overrides buffer did with each entry copy (price_level_stream_override_buffer_total). buffer_full must stay at zero: it means the 1,000,000-item limit refused entries. arrived_outside_slot_window rises while the price level websocket is down.

panels.title: Rejected entries, by reason
panels.description: Entries the parser rejected whole (price_level_stream_override_entries_refused_total). empty, about one a second, is expected and left out.

panels.title: Entries for venues not served
panels.description: Entries naming no venue the stream serves (price_level_stream_unserved_venue_entries_total). About a fifth of entries in the recording; a sudden change means Titan's venue list changed.

panels.title: Entry size, 99th percentile
panels.description: Accounts and storage values per entry (summaries; the integration test configures no buckets for them). The parser rejects entries above 32 accounts or 512 storage values.

panels.title: Messages rejected and reconnects, by websocket
panels.description: Messages a websocket sent that the stream rejected, and reconnects, by socket (price_levels or quote_stream) and reason.

panels.title: Quotes refused, by reason
panels.description: Calls a state refused (price_level_stream_quotes_refused_total). price_levels_expired means a state was asked to quote after its 12 seconds of validity.

panels.title: Price level message age
panels.description: Age of each accepted price level message when it arrived (local clock minus its ts).

panels.title: Served components, by venue
panels.description: Components the stream currently serves per venue (price_level_stream_served_components).
